## 傍門無功章第二十三
　　世人好小術，不審道深淺。棄正從邪徑，欲速閼不通。猶盲不任杖，聾者聽宮商，水捕雉兔，登山索魚龍，植麥欲獲黍，運規以求方。竭力勞精神，終年無見功。欲知伏食法，事約而不繁。
summary_en: An alchemical classic attributed to Wei Boyang, connecting the Book of Changes, cosmological cycles, and the formation of the elixir. Its imagery informed later Daoist alchemical traditions.
title: 周易參同契 · 23章
title_en: The Seal of the Unity of the Three
